defects.observed: no match (kept from the wave 10 entry)

defects.trigger: global CMODEL TMODEL; TMODEL = six template metabolites of testMetCompare; CMODEL.mets={'glc_D[c]'}; metNames={'D-Glucose'}; metFormulas={'C6H12O6'}; metCharge=0; metKEGGID={'C00031'}; metSEEDID={{'cpd00027'}}; findMetMatch(1)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) 'Invalid data type. Argument must be numeric, char, or logical.' at line 168; the KEGG branch handles a cell (lines 145-147), the SEED branch does not
defects.expected: cell SEED identifier handled like a cell KEGG identifier

notes: Revision of wave 10 (lead decision): converted to the quarantine layout; existing limitation entry kept; false 'line 146 is dead code' exemption replaced (line 146 is reached with a cell KEGG id, e.g. CMODEL.metKEGGID{1} = {'C00031'}, as testMetCompare showed). Callers metCompare and metCompareGUI reach it.
